visualCharacteristics.purpose: text column (heading, text, link) beside an embedded media player such as a Spotify playlist

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: text cell (heading, text, links) | embed cell holding only the share link of a Spotify, YouTube or Vimeo item, which becomes a lazy-loaded iframe

reuseGuidance: Use when a text column sits next to an embedded third-party player. For image/text columns use columns.
